title: SymbolicPatternReasoning BenchmarkSelection
done_summary: Successfully completed the SymbolicPatternReasoning BenchmarkSelection research task. Selected 4 benchmarks (ZOBKB, NUFES, FDLOT, GAPFD) representing diversity in SOTA accuracy, sequence length, and vocabulary size. Trained and evaluated multiple ML models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression) on each benchmark. Results show: GAPFD - Random Forest outperforms SOTA by +25.9%; FDLOT - Random Forest underperforms SOTA by -14.9%; ZOBKB/NUFES - Standard ML models perform near chance level (-41.7%/-41.8% gaps). Created comprehensive reports with visualizations and analysis in report/report.md and report/benchmark_report.md.
